title: Caernarfon Castle
visualBrief: Present-day Caernarfon: nine polygonal towers, three Eagle turrets, grey/warm banded river walls, two open wards, raised Queen's Gate and restored timber King's Gate decks.

nativeAxes.front: -Z town-facing King's Gate; +Z Seiont river curtain

identityFeatures: Eagle Tower at the west end with three tall polygonal turrets

Town-facing King's Gate and elevated Queen's Gate; open wards and contemporary timber decks
